title: sync --push re-runs itself when its rebase changed kbgit.py
goal: When the rebase inside kbgit.py sync changes _tools/kbgit.py (or a module it imports), sync does not go on with the code it loaded before the rebase: it re-executes itself on the rebased tree (or stops and asks for a rerun), so a new push rule such as code lanes applies to the same sync that brought it in; a test plants a rebase that changes kbgit.py and shows the new code decides the push (SP-xourq2gj retrospective: BG-u5wubtmv went straight to main after the code-lane change had merged)
